title.ja: Gaussian標的のMCMC：分布・自己相関・ESS
title.en: Gaussian-target MCMC: distribution, autocorrelation and ESS

summary.ja: 32本のMetropolis連鎖を既知の標準正規分布へ照合し、平均・分散・CDF、自己相関時間、ESSと標本予算依存を記録します。
summary.en: Check 32 Metropolis chains against a known standard-normal target; record mean, variance, CDF, autocorrelation time, ESS and sample-budget dependence.

assumptions.ja: 無次元1変数、対称Gaussianランダムウォーク提案幅1.5。固定master seedから32の別PCG64ストリームを生成し、1024回のburn-in後に各8192標本を保持します。
assumptions.en: One dimensionless variable and symmetric Gaussian random-walk width1.5. Spawn 32 separate PCG64 streams from a fixed master seed; retain 8192 samples per chain after 1024 burn-in steps.

algorithm.ja: log受理比でMetropolis更新。FFTによる連鎖内自己共分散を平均し、Geyerのgamma0+gamma1から始まる初期正ペア和から平均観測量のESSを求めます。古典的split-Rhatも併記します。
algorithm.en: Use a log-acceptance Metropolis update. Pool FFT within-chain autocovariances and obtain mean-observable ESS from Geyer initial-positive pairs starting at gamma0+gamma1. Also report classical split-Rhat.

validation.ja: 正規CDFを独立参照とし、標本数1024/2048/8192の連鎖平均RMSEを比較。別の定常AR(1)系列と厳密tau=(1+rho)/(1-rho)で診断量を照合します。公差は固定入力で事前指定します。
validation.en: Use the normal CDF as an independent analytic reference and compare chain-mean RMSE at 1024/2048/8192 retained samples. A separate stationary AR(1) sequence and exact tau=(1+rho)/(1-rho) check the diagnostic. Acceptance is predeclared in fixed inputs.

limits.ja: 固定seed・予算での統計検査です。ESSは平均という観測量だけ、Rhatはrank正規化版ではありません。多峰性・高次元・任意のseedでの混合や所定の偽陽性率は保証しません。
limits.en: Statistical checks apply to fixed seeds and budgets. ESS concerns the mean only; Rhat is not rank-normalized. No guarantee covers multimodality, high dimensions, every seed, mixing or a specified false-positive rate.

references.author: N. Metropolis, A. W. Rosenbluth, M. N. Rosenbluth, A. H. Teller and E. Teller
references.title: Equation of State Calculations by Fast Computing Machines

review.ja: 出版社の書誌・抄録を確認。対称提案のMetropolis受理の原著として引用し、硬い球の原著計算を再現したとは扱いません。
review.en: Publisher bibliography and abstract checked. Cited for symmetric-proposal Metropolis acceptance; no reproduction of the original hard-sphere experiment is claimed.

references.author: W. K. Hastings
references.title: Monte Carlo sampling methods using Markov chains and their applications

review.ja: 大学で公開された原著の書誌・要約と冒頭を確認。出版社DOIの通常取得はアクセスできませんでした。今回は対称Gaussian提案なので一般の非対称提案比は実装しません。
review.en: Bibliography, summary and opening excerpt of the original paper hosted by a university checked; the publisher DOI could not be opened. This example uses symmetric Gaussian proposals and does not implement a general asymmetric proposal ratio.

review.ja: 出版社側の抄録・書誌と大学公開原著の初期正列・AR(1)に関する検索返却箇所を確認。全文監査や任意の連鎖の収束証明を主張しません。
review.en: Publisher-side abstract/metadata and returned original-paper excerpts on initial-positive sequences and AR(1), from a university-hosted copy, checked. No full-text audit or convergence certificate for arbitrary chains is claimed.

title.ja: Langevin温度制御：正準分布・刻み偏り・時間相関
title.en: Langevin thermostat: canonical distributions, timestep bias and correlation

summary.ja: 調和振動子のBAOABを、正準分布と離散Lyapunov定常分布、連続・離散の時間相関へ照合します。
summary.en: Compare harmonic BAOAB with canonical and discrete-Lyapunov stationary distributions, and with continuous/discrete time correlations.

assumptions.ja: 質量・Boltzmann定数・角振動数・摩擦・温度は1。独立32768複製、burn時間20、刻み0.4/0.2/0.1、相関lag時間2。h*omega<2を要求します。
assumptions.en: Mass, Boltzmann constant, frequency, friction and temperature are one. Use 32768 replicas, burn time 20, steps 0.4/0.2/0.1 and correlation lag 2; require h*omega<2.

algorithm.ja: 力B・ドリフトAの半ステップと厳密OUノイズ更新OをB-A-O-A-Bで合成。サンプルの共分散・3種のCDF・エネルギー平均/分散・位置相関を記録します。
algorithm.en: Compose force B and drift A half steps with exact OU noise O in B-A-O-A-B order. Record covariance, three CDFs, energy mean/variance and position correlation.

validation.ja: SciPy離散Lyapunov解および調和系の明示共分散diag(T/omega²,T(1-h²omega²/4))で照合。運動量の刻み2次偏りと有限標本誤差を分離し、burn過渡を写像で評価。連続相関は別の行列指数で算出します。
validation.en: Check against a SciPy discrete-Lyapunov solve and explicit harmonic covariance diag(T/omega²,T(1-h²omega²/4)). Separate second-order momentum bias from sampling error and evaluate burn transients from the map. A separate matrix exponential gives continuous correlation.

limits.ja: 調和ポテンシャル・固定seedの分布検証です。位置分散が正確でも運動量には有限刻み偏りがあります。他のサーモスタット、一般分子系、長時間の第一原理MDへ検証を移しません。
limits.en: Distribution checks use a harmonic potential and fixed seeds. Exact position variance does not remove finite-step momentum bias. Evidence does not transfer to other thermostats, general molecules or long ab initio MD.

references.author: B. Leimkuhler and C. Matthews
references.title: Rational Construction of Stochastic Numerical Methods for Molecular Sampling

review.ja: 著者稿の抄録、Langevin式、付録のBAOAB更新式（印刷22ページ）を確認。一般分子の超収束や原著の長時間計算を再現したとは主張しません。
review.en: Author manuscript abstract, Langevin equation and BAOAB update in the appendix (printed page 22) checked. The original long molecular runs and general-system superconvergence are not reproduced here.

review.ja: 公式の離散Lyapunov方程式AXA^H-X+Q=0の符号と返却仕様を確認。
review.en: Official equation AXA^H-X+Q=0, signs and output specification checked.

review.ja: 公式の行列指数APIとPadé/scaling-and-squaring法の記載を確認。
review.en: Official matrix-exponential API and description of the Pade/scaling-and-squaring method checked.

title.ja: 反応拡散：空間2次と時間4次を分けて測る
title.en: Reaction-diffusion: separate second-order space and fourth-order time

summary.ja: 線形の拡散・反応演算子を、連続と半離散のFourier厳密解を用いて小規模に検証します。
summary.en: Validate a small linear diffusion-reaction operator against continuous and semidiscrete Fourier solutions.

assumptions.ja: 周期区間[0,2pi)、D=0.1、r=0.1、初期cos(2x)、終了t=2。格子16/32/64と、別の固定格子で刻み0.5/0.25/0.125を用います。
assumptions.en: Periodic[0,2pi), D=0.1,r=0.1, initial cos(2x), final t=2. Use grids 16/32/64 and a separate fixed-grid timestep sequence 0.5/0.25/0.125.

algorithm.ja: 周期中心2階差分と独自RK4で進めます。空間系列は小さな同一時間刻み、時間系列は同じ空間演算子を用います。
algorithm.en: Advance original periodic second-centered differences with RK4. The spatial sequence uses one small time step; the temporal sequence fixes the spatial operator.

validation.ja: 連続固有値r-Dk²への最大誤差で空間次数、半離散固有値r-4Dsin²(kdx/2)/dx²への最大誤差で時間次数を測ります。独立した解析参照であり同じ実装の細格子値を参照にしません。
validation.en: Measure spatial order against r-Dk² and temporal order against r-4Dsin²(kdx/2)/dx². Both are independent analytic references, rather than a finer-grid run of the same solver.

limits.ja: 線形・周期・滑らかな単一モードだけを検証します。非線形のFisher前線、複雑境界、空間生態系や一般の反応ネットワークの検証ではありません。
limits.en: Only a linear, periodic, smooth single mode is verified. Nonlinear Fisher fronts, complex boundaries, spatial ecosystems and general reaction networks remain outside scope.

review.ja: 公式の行列指数APIとPadé/scaling-and-squaring法の記載を確認。
review.en: Official matrix-exponential API and description of the Pade/scaling-and-squaring method checked.

title.ja: Turing不安定性：線形成長率と小振幅パターン
title.en: Turing instability: linear growth and small-amplitude patterns

summary.ja: Schnakenberg型反応拡散で、一様平衡の安定性と拡散による選択モードの成長を行列指数で検証します。
summary.en: Use a matrix exponential to validate stable homogeneous kinetics and diffusion-driven growth of a selected Schnakenberg mode.

assumptions.ja: 無次元a=0.1,b=0.9、平衡(1,0.9)、拡散係数(0.01,1)、周期k=2、初期振幅1e-4。線形t=1と非線形t=4の短い計算に限定します。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless a=0.1,b=0.9, equilibrium(1,0.9), diffusivities(0.01,1), periodic k=2 and initial amplitude1e-4. Restrict runs to linear t=1 and nonlinear t=4.

algorithm.ja: 独自の中心差分・RK4で線形化PDEと短い非線形PDEを進めます。3格子でのモード振幅と成長率、非線形の濃度最小値・初期パターン増幅を記録します。
algorithm.en: Advance the linearized and short nonlinear PDEs using original centered differences/RK4. Record mode amplitudes/growth on three grids, minimum concentrations and early-pattern amplification.

validation.ja: 連続Fourier行列J-k²DのSciPy expmと線形数値解を比較し空間収束を測定。非線形計算は半離散線形行列指数との小振幅差を測り、成熟模様の参照照合とは区別します。
validation.en: Compare linear numerical fields with SciPy expm of continuum J-k²D and measure spatial convergence. Quantify the nonlinear run against a semidiscrete linear matrix exponential as a small-amplitude check, not validation of mature morphology.

limits.ja: 1つの平衡近傍の発生段階です。原著係数や原著実験の再現、成熟模様、ランダム擾乱からの波数選択、実生物の較正は主張しません。
limits.en: One near-equilibrium onset experiment. No claim reproduces original-paper parameters/experiments, mature patterns, wavenumber selection from random noise or biological calibration.

references.author: A. M. Turing
references.title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis

review.ja: Royal Societyの原稿審査記録と大学公開の原著第1ページの書誌を確認。出版社本文は403でした。拡散誘起不安定性の歴史的原著で、採用したSchnakenberg数値例の出典とは区別します。
review.en: Royal Society manuscript-review archive and bibliography on the original first page hosted by a university checked. Publisher text returned 403. Historical source for diffusion-driven instability, distinct from this adopted Schnakenberg example.

references.journal: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B237(641),37–72

references.author: J. Schnakenberg
references.title: Simple chemical reaction systems with limit cycle behaviour

review.ja: PubMedの書誌・DOIを確認（抄録なし）。反応系の原典として引用し、採用係数a=0.1,b=0.9や今回の空間パターンを原著から転記したとは扱いません。
review.en: PubMed bibliography and DOI checked (no abstract). Cited for the reaction-system family; a=0.1,b=0.9 and this spatial experiment are adopted educational inputs, not a transcription of the original experiment.

review.ja: 公式の行列指数APIとPadé/scaling-and-squaring法の記載を確認。
review.en: Official matrix-exponential API and description of the Pade/scaling-and-squaring method checked.

title.ja: FitzHugh–Nagumo：パルス興奮・回復と独立ODE参照
title.en: FitzHugh-Nagumo: pulse excitation, recovery and an independent ODE reference

summary.ja: 2変数の膜興奮縮約ODEを電流パルスで励起し、DOP853との全出力時刻の誤差・時間収束・回復を確認します。
summary.en: Excite a two-variable reduced membrane ODE with a current pulse; check all-output-time errors, temporal refinement and recovery against DOP853.

assumptions.ja: 無次元a=0.7,b=0.8,tau=12.5。I=0の休止平衡からt=10〜20だけI=0.8を与え、t=80まで進めます。生理学的な物理単位への較正はしません。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless a=0.7,b=0.8,tau=12.5. Start at resting equilibrium for I=0, apply I=0.8 only during t=10..20 and integrate to t=80. No calibration to physiological physical units.

algorithm.ja: 独自RK4を刻み0.1/0.05/0.025で使用し、パルスの不連続点で時間区間を厳密に分割します。出力刻み0.1でピークと休止状態からの距離も測定します。
algorithm.en: Use original RK4 with steps 0.1/0.05/0.025, splitting time intervals exactly at pulse discontinuities. At output spacing 0.1, measure the peak and distance from rest.

validation.ja: 別実装SciPy DOP853のrtol1e-11と1e-13を比較して参照の感度を確認し、厳しい参照への最大解誤差と時間次数を評価します。ピーク時刻は出力格子上の精度です。
validation.en: Compare separate SciPy DOP853 at rtol=1e-11 and 1e-13 to check reference sensitivity; measure maximum solution error and time order against the tighter reference. Peak time is resolved only on the output grid.

limits.ja: FHN/BVP型の縮約ODEの限定検証です。HH全イオンチャネル、空間軸索、患者データ、実測電気生理の再現を含みません。
limits.en: Scoped verification of an FHN/BVP-style reduced ODE. It excludes full HH ion channels, spatial axons, patient data and experimental electrophysiology reproduction.

references.author: R. FitzHugh
references.title: Impulses and Physiological States in Theoretical Models of Nerve Membrane

review.ja: PubMedの原著抄録・書誌を確認。2変数の興奮・不応期の縮約という役割を参照し、HH全系や実測膜電位の再現とは区別します。
review.en: Original-paper abstract and bibliography in PubMed checked. Supports the two-variable excitable/refractory reduction; no full HH or measured membrane-voltage reproduction is claimed.

references.author: J. Nagumo, S. Arimoto and S. Yoshizawa
references.title: An Active Pulse Transmission Line Simulating Nerve Axon

review.ja: IEEE出版社の抄録・巻号・頁・DOIを確認。縮約した膜興奮と回路の歴史的な原著として参照し、空間的な伝送線路や回路実験を今回再現したとは扱いません。
review.en: IEEE publisher abstract, volume, pages and DOI checked. Historical source for reduced excitation and its circuit analogue; no spatial transmission-line or hardware-experiment reproduction is claimed.

review.ja: 公式のDOP853、dense_output、許容誤差、successの仕様を確認。独立数値参照の実装資料です。
review.en: Official DOP853, dense output, tolerance and success specifications checked. Implementation documentation for the separate numerical reference.
